dm_message:
Hi La Rivière Bakery — I found La Rivière Bakery while looking for services in Fort Lauderdale, FL. I could not find a dedicated website linked from your public profile, so I put together a clean page using your public photos and contact details:

https://siteforge-demos.odd-forest-9504.workers.dev/la-rivire-bakery/

It gives a new customer one clear place to see your work and call or message you. No login and no change to your current booking flow — just take a look.

Would you like me to tailor the colors and domain for you? If it is not useful, reply “no” and I will not follow up.

— José Michael from Merktop
